title: Reject colon characters in world overlay ids and fields
description: Correctness review finding. The mutate_state tool passes field through raw. World overlay keys are built as world type id field joined by colons; if an id or field contains a colon, two different id/field pairs can serialize to the same overlay_facts key and silently overwrite each other. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: World overlay ids and field names containing a colon are rejected at the mutate_state and worldOverlayKey boundary; tests cover colliding pairs.
